content.short: Mercado Bitcoin is Brazil's largest and longest-running crypto platform, with hundreds of assets, digital fixed income and crypto loans.
content.description: Mercado Bitcoin has operated in Brazil since 2013 and serves millions of customers. Users trade hundreds of assets in reais around the clock, earn through staking and tokenized fixed-income products, and borrow against their crypto with CriptoCrédito. For companies and institutions, the group offers prime services, asset management through MB Asset and a corporate API. It is part of 2TM Group and lists hundreds of crypto assets, from major coins to newer tokens, all priced in reais.
